howItWorksPage.title: A calm, transparent way to find a puppy
howItWorksPage.subtitle: Anemalo is a specialist marketplace for responsibly bred puppies — not a classified ads site. Every kennel is verified, every litter is confirmed, and every application flows through a structured process.
howItWorksPage.stepsTitle: Five steps from start to finish
howItWorksPage.step1Desc: Search verified kennels and current or planned litters. Save what interests you.
howItWorksPage.step2Desc: A structured form helps the breeder understand your home and plans.
howItWorksPage.step3Desc: The breeder reviews, asks questions or invites you to a video call.
howItWorksPage.step4Desc: Pay a deposit and sign the sales agreement — everything is tracked here.
howItWorksPage.step5Title: Collect the puppy or arrange transport
howItWorksPage.step5Desc: Meet in person, or book safe transport across Europe.
howItWorksPage.trustVerifiedDesc: Identity, kennel and association membership checked.

howItWorksPage.reviewsDesc: To keep reviews honest, buyers can only leave a review after a confirmed reservation and handover. Reviews cover communication, accuracy of information, puppy condition at handover, documents and overall experience. Transport has its own separate review.

transportPage.title: Four transport categories, one professional standard
